items.title: Alphonse Picou Interview, 1958-04-04
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you ever have any business with George Lewis? ... [INTERVIEWEE] George Lewis. ... [INTERVIEWER] ... You didn't play at the same time he did around, did you...? No. No.
